title: Mr. Pregnant
overview: Gautham, a renowned tattoo artist marries his love Mahi,under the condition that they won't have children. When Mahi becomes pregnant, Gautham, who strongly dislikes kids, struggles with this situation and surprisingly decides to carry the baby himself.

songs.title: Vinara Eeswara (From "Mr Pregnant")
songs.singers: Kalyan Chakravarthy, Kaala Bhairava, Shravan Bharadwaj
